intro: Deep within Thistlefur Hold in northern Ashenvale, a caged bear named Ruul awaits rescue from the corrupted Thistlefur furbolgs. Horde adventurers can assist the captive in fighting his way out of the furbolg den to safety.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend? You're no furbolg. They are cursed! They thought I was a bear and captured me, and now they starve me! My strength is failing...
Help me escape, then speak with my sister Yama at the Splintertree Post to the east.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you seen my brother Ruul? He walked into the forest days ago and has not returned...

clips.title: Completion
paras: You found my brother! He was captured by the Thistlefurs? That is terrible news to hear, for although many furbolgs are noble creatures, the Thistlefurs are corrupt.
Thank you for rescuing my brother, friend. I do not want to think of how they treated poor Ruul. He will likely sleep long after this ordeal...

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
